attributes.action: No curfew on phones for 16-17year olds!
attributes.additional_details: At the age of 16-17 you can learn to drive, you can also join the army. this is a unfair matter and taking away our rights. this should not even be a debate as at 16 you can get a full time job so why cant i go on a phone at night? Keir stamar has argued saying at 16 you should be able to vote and fully join the army.
attributes.background: I disagree with the curfew the government is talking about. i believe 16-18 year olds should have there own freedom we arent children at this age we have things we need to do on our phones. At that age i can join the army but i cant go on my phone. i can also learn to drive at this age  and have job

rejection.details: You may wish to sign this petition, which calls for similar action: "Do not introduce social media curfew for 16 & 17 year olds" https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/772675
